summary.value: Following the widespread community adoption of the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 series, we are pleased to introduce Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date.

value.notes: Qwen3.8 27B (Xhigh); mini-swe-agent harness, pass@1 averaged over three repeats.
